 Dallas Weather: Midweek warmup before cold front brings cooler temperatures
 By Ali Turiano FOX 4 Weather Published  November 9, 2026 5:37 AM CST Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Published  November 9, 2026 5:37 AM CST Dallas Weather: Nov. 9 morning forecast 
 FOX 4's Ali Turiano has the morning forecast for Nov. 9
 The Brief
 Thick cloud cover and low shower chances start the work week across North Texas, keeping afternoon highs in the low 70s. 
 A warming trend pushes temperatures into the upper 70s Wednesday ahead of a dry cold front.  
 Gusty north winds will clear the skies Wednesday night, bringing cooler temperatures and plenty of sunshine to wrap up the week.  
 DALLAS - North Texas faces thick cloud cover and slight rain chances early in the week before a midweek cold front brings cooler temperatures.
 Midweek Cold Front to Sweep Away Clouds 
 What we know:
 Low shower chances sit at 20% Monday, focusing primarily south and southwest of the Metroplex before shifting closer to Dallas-Fort Worth in the evening.
 Any leftover morning showers Tuesday will move east of the Interstate 35 corridor, leaving most locations with less than one-hundredth of an inch of measurable rain.
 Heavy rainfall remains confined to parts of Central Texas, the Hill Country, and South Texas, where the primary weather disturbance is passing.
 A cold front will move through on Wednesday, ushering in gusty northerly winds, clear skies, and cooler conditions for Thursday and Friday.
 Morning lows start chilly along the Red River in the mid-40s, while the Metroplex begins in the low to mid-50s and reaches near 72 degrees Monday afternoon.
 Radar: Dallas-Fort Worth
 Regional Weather Impacts 
 Local perspective:
 While South Texas and the Hill Country deal with major flood concerns from the main energy of the system, North Texas stays largely quiet. 
 Spotty showers will bring little to no measurable relief to the Metroplex, and forecasters expect no severe storms or thunderstorms with this system.
 DFW 7-Day Forecast
 The Source: The information in this article comes from FOX 4's Ali Turiano.
